title: The Hungry Winter
text: The snow came early and stayed, heaped to the sills, and the river froze solid. The granaries of the lower town are scraped bare. The poor queue at every House's kitchen door in the dark before dawn, silent, their breath hanging over them. Some of them are children.

temptation.label: Sell your surplus to the speculators instead.
temptation.text: The grain merchants pay well, and ask no questions about who goes without.

triumph.text: No one starves. The common folk remember whose wagons came.

holds.text: A hard winter, but the city holds. Some of the night shelters are quieter than they should be.

falters.text: The old and the very young die in the night shelters, and the gravediggers find the ground already open.

calamity.text: Famine. The recruit halls empty as the hungry flee, and in the lower town the Houses are cursed, and worse is eaten.
